limitations: The exact maximum-cardinality table is restricted to a three-symbol multiset alphabet, exactly two unordered deletions, and integer lengths six through twenty. It neither classifies all maximizers nor proves results above twenty. Unindexed equivalent tables may exist.
scientific_integrity: A finite, exact result proved by complete primal witnesses and rational clique-cover upper certificates. The attached checker verifies every constraint over integer and rational arithmetic, not asymptotic extrapolation; independent validation is absent.
title: Sharp ternary multiset two-deletion code sizes through length twenty
